subject: [PATCH v2 2/2] scsi: mpt3sas: Time out delayed not-responding device blocks

2026-11-02.patch_summary: This patch addresses a deadlock issue in the mpt3sas driver, where a device block caused by a DELAY_NOT_RESPONDING event prevents further scan attempts from proceeding. The patch introduces a delayed_work to unblock expired sdevs after a missing delay plus 30 seconds, ensuring that devices are not stuck waiting for the lock. This fix builds upon an earlier partial solution and ensures that LUN 0 is also handled correctly during scans.
